other_conditions: The worker must be engaged in building or construction work
The worker must be registered with the Bihar Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board
The worker must have maintained continuous membership with the Board for at least three years
The worker's membership must be active at the time of application
Workers who remarry are not eligible for this scheme
Benefits are available for the marriage of two adult daughters; female workers are also eligible for assistance for their own marriage
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹50,000 is provided to eligible workers for the marriage of their two adult daughters, and additionally for the female worker’s own marriage.
